# Zigbee2MQTT Gateways

Read or control supported child-device capabilities through an existing Zigbee2MQTT gateway using Muse Home Link, via its authorized local MQTT broker, configured base topic and actual exposed properties (Paho MQTT client). It reads bridge info/devices and each target's definition.exposes before acting and honours the expose access bitmask. It is not gateway setup or device pairing: no new broker/gateway installation, no join-mode changes and no device removal.
